entries.text: Hey, welcome to Blueberry Academy!\c\nIt’s pretty wild the first time you come to school\nby riding a subway to an undersea elevator, huh?
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_01_01

entries.text: Way to go, new Champion! Pretty impressive that\nyou managed to take down Kieran.
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_01_02

entries.text: Things have been extra lively here at school\nsince you showed up!
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_01_03

entries.text: I forget which biome my next class is in...
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_05_01

entries.text: We gotta bundle up if we’re headed to the Polar\nBiome. Brrr...
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_06_01

entries.text: So you’re the exchange student people keep\ntalking about? You don’t LOOK that strong...
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_11_01

entries.text: At our school, you won’t cut it if you can’t hold\nyour own in a Pokémon battle.
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_12_01

entries.text: From how you look, I’d never have guessed what\na good Pokémon battler you are!
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_11_02

entries.text: I can’t believe Kieran lost to you. Not even\nDrayton could beat Kieran!
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_12_02

entries.text: I want to get as strong as you are!
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_11_03

entries.text: Paldea must be full of skilled battlers like you!
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_12_03

entries.text: Man, no matter how many Poké Balls I have, it’s\nnever enough...
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_14_01

entries.text: You should go do some BBQs. Once you’ve\nearned the BP, you can buy some nice Poké Balls.
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_15_01

entries.text: This court’s used for official BB League battles!\c\nYou should see how packed the seats get when\nthere’s a Championship match!
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_22_01

entries.text: I saw your battle with Lacey! I’d never seen some\nof those Pokémon before!
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_23_01

entries.text: Your Championship battle ruled! So is Kieran\ndemoted back down to the Elite Four now?
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_22_02

entries.text: I saw your battle with Kieran! He sure looked\nunhappy about the outcome, though...
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_23_02

entries.text: I wanna become Champion one day too! I gotta\nput in a lot of work first...
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_22_03

entries.text: After seeing you battle so much, I think I’m a fan\nof yours now!
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_23_03

entries.text:
Here at Blueberry Academy, it’s Double Battles
or nothing.\c
I guess that’s probably because they open up
your strategic options.
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_26_01

entries.text: Why not try catching a Rhyhorn in the Savanna\nBiome?
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_48_01

entries.text: I just can’t get my head around the material in\nRock-Type Studies II...
entries.label: bbschool_entrance_npc_49_01

entries.text: Plusle’s Ability is called Plus!\c\nIt gets a boost to its Sp. Atk when it battles\nalongside Minun!
entries.label: bbschool_class_a_eve_npc_01

entries.text: I can’t remember my type matchups. I keep\nhaving to look at my notes during battle.
entries.label: bbschool_class_a_eve_npc_10

entries.text:
Type matchups are much easier to grasp when
you think about how the world works!\c
Plants wither in the cold, right? So logically,
Grass types are weak to the Ice type!
entries.label: bbschool_class_a_eve_npc_11

entries.text: This classroom’s actually underwater!\c\nThey just display video of the sky on these\nscreens so it doesn’t feel too claustrophobic.
entries.label: bbschool_class_a_ni_npc_03

entries.text: When it’s night outside, the sky you see in the\nTerarium will look like night too. The displays are\r\nsynced to the real time on the surface.
entries.label: bbschool_class_a_ni_npc_04

entries.text: Yeah, Carmine’s kinda self-absorbed, but it’s\nhard not to like her anyway.
entries.label: bbschool_class_b_eve_npc_01

entries.text: Our class has Amarys, the student council prez...\nand Carmine, the student body pest!
entries.label: bbschool_class_b_eve_npc_02

entries.text: Did you know that if you run in tight circles for a\nbit, you’ll end up spinning in place?
entries.label: bbschool_class_b_eve_npc_08

entries.text: There’s this one spot down in the Terarium’s\nmeadows where there’s always a breeze blowing.\r\nIt’d be fun to go spin and spin in the wind there.
entries.label: bbschool_class_b_eve_npc_09

entries.text: One time I was walking in the meadows in the\nTerarium when a breeze blew in out of nowhere.\r\nI thought I heard someone singing... So weird!
entries.label: bbschool_class_b_ni_npc_02

entries.text: I wanna work at a Poké Mart in the future, so I’m\nresearching what items here are big sellers.
entries.label: bbschool_shop_eve_npc_01

entries.text: If you want a TM, but you can’t make it ’cause\nyou need some material that a Pokémon drops...\r\nyou can just buy the TM with BP here instead!
entries.label: bbschool_shop_eve_npc_06

entries.text: The move Helping Hand does wonderful things in\nDouble Battles!
entries.label: bbschool_shop_eve_npc_07

entries.text: You can buy Poké Balls and Potions from vending\nmachines around the Terarium.
entries.label: bbschool_shop_eve_npc_09

entries.text: Which Pokémon can I use a hunk of Metal Alloy\non...? Guess it’s gotta be a metallic one...
entries.label: bbschool_shop_ni_npc_01

entries.text: The dishes here taste super rich, but they give\nMeal Powers that help with all Pokémon types!\r\nIf you’ve got the BP, try ’em out!
entries.label: bbschool_dining_eve_npc_03

entries.text: The Canyon Biome’s the best for picnicking!\nIt feels nice just being in Amarys’s territory!
entries.label: bbschool_dining_eve_npc_04

entries.text: There’s no better place to enjoy a sandwich than\nthe Coastal Biome! Lacey’s plaza is there too!
entries.label: bbschool_dining_eve_npc_05

entries.text: You’ve got to clear the Elite Trials if you want\na shot at battling the Elite Four.
entries.label: bbschool_dining_eve_npc_14

entries.text: I can’t handle heights! No way can I do Amarys’s\nElite Trial!
entries.label: bbschool_dining_eve_npc_15

entries.text: I think Drayton’s my favorite of the Elite Four.\nHe’s so strong, even though he seems so lazy!
entries.label: bbschool_dining_ni_npc_03

entries.text: Crispin of the Elite Four... He’s kinda absent-\nminded, but that’s pretty cute!
entries.label: bbschool_dining_ni_npc_04

entries.text: Brrr. I’m still chilly from a jaunt in the Polar\nBiome. Better warm up with a slice of pizza!
entries.label: bbschool_dining_ni_npc_09

entries.text:
Every dish here at the cafeteria is a personal
favorite of Director Cyrano’s!\c
None of them look very...balanced, nutritionally
speaking—but the Meal Powers are unbelievable!
entries.label: bbschool_dining_ni_npc_13

entries.text: My Tyrogue loves this treadmill!
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_default_02

entries.text: Pikachu and I are doing our best to fight our way\nup the BB League!
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_default_03

entries.text: The clubroom’s so flashy now. Meowth loves it!
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_gorgeous_03

entries.text: Meowth has its claws out and looks eager to\nuse them!
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_gorgeous_04

entries.text: Lacey must love the clubroom’s new fancy look!
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_fancy_02

entries.text: Metang looks right at home when the clubroom’s\ndone up like this!
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_future_02

entries.text: Man, the room looks cool this way! Way to go,\nArt Club!
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_future_04

entries.text: W-wait, isn’t that the mysterious UFO?! Like,\nthe one from the movies?!
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_future_06

entries.text: Some of the Pokémon hanging out in this room\nseem like the sort to make holes in things.\r\nI sure hope they don’t...
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_retro_02

entries.text: Blitzle blends right in with the room’s new black-\nand-white decor! It’s so cute!
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_monotone_01

entries.text: Skarmory’s really tough—did you know that? It’s\ngot very few weaknesses.
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_monotone_04

entries.text: You brought nature right to the clubroom! The\ngrass Pokémon look thrilled about it!
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_natural_02

entries.text: Thank you for veiling the clubroom in this\ndarkness. We’re grateful for the gloom.
entries.label: bbschool_clubroom_dark_05
